Welcome to Computable AI, a machine intelligence blog intended to crystalize, internalize, share, and explain.

I found few beginner resources for deep reinforcement learning when I began, and since I have a passion for teaching, this seemed a likely area in which to make a dent.

My own education in machine intelligence is incomplete, so this also serves partly as a record of my own journey.

I hope it helps you.
